full_clause_decisions.clause: Countable boxes of arbitrarily small total volume are exactly Lebesgue-null sets in every finite dimension
full_clause_decisions.explanation: The proof constructs real enclosing coordinate boxes for an actual countable Hausdorff cover, uses genuine sup-metric Hausdorff=product Lebesgue, and bounds their total volume by2^d times the covering cost. The converse uses countable outer-measure subadditivity for arbitrary N. Option None is genuine empty padding; Some is a closed coordinate box with its actual volume. Dimension0 and empty families are handled rather than assuming positive dimension for this equivalence.

full_clause_decisions.clause: Each printed finite-set, planar-line, nonzero-normal hyperplane and finite-union example
full_clause_decisions.explanation: Finite sets explicitly require positive dimension. Nonzero dot normal gives a genuine nonzero linear functional and proper affine subspace, whose actual Lebesgue measure is zero. Every affine planar line, including zero direction/singleton, is proved null. Subset and finite-union claims use the same actual box/Lebesgue correspondence.

Actual ae is failure-set measure0; Euclidean ae is bridged to the displayed countable-box definition. An event is measurable and the actual probability measure has total mass1, giving ae iff event probability1. No arbitrary nonmeasurable event is silently called an event.

full_clause_decisions.clause: Essential supremum is the infimum and attained least almost-sure upper bound
full_clause_decisions.explanation: Bounds are conventionally extended real, including+infinity for unbounded real random variables. The real measurable random variable is explicitly embedded into EReal. The infimum formula is exactly Mathlib essSup, and a genuine IsLeast theorem proves both its a.s. bound membership and leastness; no finite upper bound is presumed.

hypotheses: Ambient coordinate dimension is finite; finite-set example explicitly has positive dimension.
Hyperplane normal is nonzero; all planar lines include the degenerate singleton case.
Almost-sure event and random variable are measurable on an actual probability space.
individual_decisions.essential_supremum_convention: The printed infimum and smallest a.s. bound use extended real c. The neighboring extended-limit context and both original pending rows explicitly require this convention; unbounded real Z has+infinity as its least extended a.s. upper bound.
